app.name: Arya Vysya Vamsha Vruksham
app.tagline: The verified family tree of the Arya Vysya community
app.footer: Maintained with the district in-charges, local sanghas & sabhas and state Mahasabhas · Om Sri Vasavi Kanyaka Parameswari Namaha

home.heroTitle: Preserve your family's vamsham for generations
home.heroBody: Record your ancestors, gotra, intiperu and native place. Every member is endorsed by their local sangha or sabha and verified by the district in-charge, and each family keeps its own branch accurate.
home.step1Body: Create an account and tell us your family details and district.
home.step2Body: Your local sangha / sabha endorses you, and the district in-charge confirms you belong to the family and links you to the tree.
home.step3Body: Edit your own family up to 5 generations above and below you.
home.pendingNotice: Your membership is waiting for verification by the {district} district in-charge.

match.intro: Check two people before an alliance: the same gotra (sagotra) is traditionally not permitted, and close blood relatives are flagged.
